newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU experts continue discussion on rice duties.
newsitem.headline: EU experts continue discussion on rice duties.

text.p: European Union cereals experts will discuss a Commission proposal for a new rice import system on Wednesday ahead of a vote in the cereals management committee the next day, an EU member state official said on Tuesday.
"An experts group has been scheduled for Wednesday afternoon and Thursday morning and a vote is scheduled for the management committee," the official said.
A vote was postponed at last week's meeting because many member states objected to the new draft regulation setting up a cumulative recovery system for allowing traders to reclaim overpaid duties.

The Commission wants a decision before the March 20 deadline when the World Trade Organisation's (WTO) Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) meets to hear a long-standing U.S. complaint against EU import tariffs for grain, including rice.
The U.S. argues that the tariffs infringe arrangements made under the GATT Uruguay Round trade agreement. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
